arc: networkd: Generalize ARC lifecycle notifications. This patch removes the signalling mechanism used to indicate when ARC++ starts and stops and replaces it with a simple text protocol over an abstract domain socket. This allows us to use the same upstart scripts without overlay for detecting both ARC++ and ARCVM. Recall this is intended to be temporary until the guests connect directly to the daemon. This change in turn requires message propagation to the child tasks (both adb proxy and ip helper) and the appropriate refactoring was done. The expansion of the protos is required anyway eventually to support notifications for multiple guests. Regenerate the mock owner public key and metric_{on,off} policies At some point, the acceptable format for the owner key changed, in terms of header sizes. This can be seen in commit d29ae33459d4 ("Updated policy_testserver to support verification key signatures"), in the chrome repo. Unfortunately, the code in this directory was not updated. As a result, if a user had logged into a test machine at any point before running platform_KernelErrorPaths (i.e. the machine has an owner), the test machine gets powerwashed and the test fails. The original code for generating the public key and the policy blobs is found attached to this document: https://sites.google.com/a/google.com/chromeos/archive/testing-tools-for-device-policies Along with it are the instructions to generate the keys. We follow these instructions and commit the updated code. TEST=platform_KernelErrorPaths.BUG passes after this. Tried running platform_KernelErrorPaths.ALL, but it has other issues. UPSTREAM: BACKPORT: ACPI / button: increment wakeup count only when notified Because acpi_lid_initialize_state() is called on every system resume and it triggers acpi_lid_notify_state() which invokes acpi_pm_wakeup_event() for the lid device, the lid's wakeup count is incremented even if the lid was not the source of the event that woke up the system. That behavior confuses user space deamons using wakeup_count to identify the potential system wakeup source. To avoid the confusion, only trigger acpi_pm_wakeup_event() in the acpi_button_notify() path and don't do that in the acpi_lid_initialize_state() path. BUG=b:65976859 TEST=Not yet tested. UPSTREAM: BACKPORT: ACPI / button: increment wakeup count only when notified Because acpi_lid_initialize_state() is called on every system resume and it triggers acpi_lid_notify_state() which invokes acpi_pm_wakeup_event() for the lid device, the lid's wakeup count is incremented even if the lid was not the source of the event that woke up the system. That behavior confuses user space deamons using wakeup_count to identify the potential system wakeup source. To avoid the confusion, only trigger acpi_pm_wakeup_event() in the acpi_button_notify() path and don't do that in the acpi_lid_initialize_state() path. BUG=b:65976859 TEST=update_kernel.sh on nocturne and make sure wakeup count for PNP0C0D does not increment, if not the wake source.
